external_chain: For each new TRAIN/validation full program, call the frozen candidate greedily on one command with current emitted state. Parse only complete exactly four ASCII digits separated by single spaces and nativeEOS, within unchanged cap16; pass that emitted state to the next command even when numerically wrong. No oracle is called to construct a step prompt or route state. No repair, filtering, prefix rescue, constrained decoder, EOS injection or state replacement. Save all inputs, prompts, token IDs and final emission. Malformed or missingEOS aborts the chain. A propagated input equal to an original fixed demonstration input also aborts before inference to retain the frozen demonstration-separation boundary; no alternate examples are chosen.

scope: External composition of qualified native single-command predictions followed by persistent final-answer imitation within known synthetic device conventions. A teacher-free full-program TEST success is bounded internal-composition behavior on unseen ordered programs, not proof of a latent algorithm, general continual learning, native-base consolidation, unknown-domain transfer or SDFT/SDPO reproduction. An oracle-only result establishes a supervised composition reference, not transfer from a rejected teacher.
